name: ribbon_waves
coordinate_system: native pixel-centre coordinates: centre of pixel (i,j) = (i+0.5, j+0.5); x right, y down; angles absolute radians with y down (increasing theta sweeps visually clockwise); vertex = (x + r*cos(theta), y + r*sin(theta)); theta_end_abs > theta_start, sweep < pi; circles r=22 native; ribbons[].pieces are annular sectors in native coordinates; world transform in `world`.

provenance.notes: One smooth centreline per ribbon (per-column silhouette midpoint, smoothing spline, 400 uniform arc-length points). Pieces are single circular arcs through exact spline endpoints; adjacent pieces share their boundary point exactly (max gap 0.000000 px). Constant thickness per ribbon = median perpendicular width. Real brick seams only (gold runs + mask slits + bevel dips); no per-brick raster fitting. Native coordinates use pixel centres (+0.5).

measurements.screenshot_note: reference visible ball r=14.5 px, outer peg r=24 px (0.604); automated cyan min-enclosing-circle 13.87 px and gold-rim p95 23.21 px agree
